clause_label_addition: In the answer field, visibly label each literal requested clause and each named alternative, then give its answer under that label. Check the labels against the question before saving so that no requested clause or alternative is merged away.
evidence_instruction: complete verbatim sentences, bullet points, or table rows from the summary that support each resolved requested part. Do not use ellipses or omit text within a quoted unit. Include the applicable conditions and exceptions. Section labels alone are insufficient; identify unsupported parts explicitly.
neutrality: All literal questions uniformly; labels come from the question and quoted units from the same permitted summary. No supplied game fact, expected answer, question ID, failure example, grader reasoning or feedback.
generic_authorization_basis: Coordinator permitted neutral visible requested-clause enumeration/self-check with no facts/IDs/examples/feedback. Quotation format remains within source-only evidence and existing whole-response policy.
